android.desc:
Slack helps companies big and small turn chaos into cohesive collaboration.

It’s one place where you can have meetings, collaborate on documents, share files, access your favorite apps, work alongside external partners, and use AI and agents to get ahead.

With Slack, you have everything you need to grow your business. 

💬 Talk things out with your team
• Stay organized with a dedicated channel for every project.
• Work alongside your team, customers, contractors, and vendors from anywhere in the world.
• Video chat directly in Slack, and share your screen to present and discuss work live.
• When typing doesn’t cut it, record and send audio or video clips to share complicated ideas clearly.

🎯 Keep projects on track
• Set projects up for success with pre-made and customizable* templates.
• Collaborate on marketing plans, product specs, and more in shared docs that live right next to your team’s conversations.
• Track to-dos, assign tasks, and map out milestones with project management tools.*

⚙️ Tap into all of your tools
• Access 2,600+ apps, including Google Drive, Salesforce Data Cloud, Dropbox, Asana, Zapier, Figma, and Zendesk.
• Approve requests, manage your calendar, and update file permissions without leaving Slack.
• Find files, messages, and information instantly with AI-powered search.**
Use Slack AI to take meeting notes, so you and your teammates can stay focused.**

*Requires an upgrade to Slack Pro, Business+, or Enterprise.

**Requires Slack AI add-on.
